problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted campaigns
Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Establish strict verification procedures for financial transactions
Monitor email accounts for unusual login activity and forwarding rules

problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage buckets or services expose sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users, leading to data breaches.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers target software or hardware suppliers to inject malicious code or backdoors, compromising downstream customers.
risk_reduction: Conduct rigorous third-party risk assessments
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and code integrity checks
Monitor for anomalous supplier behavior and patch promptly

problems.description: Use of AI to create highly convincing, personalized phishing messages at scale, increasing success rates of social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools to identify synthetic content
Enhance user awareness of AI-generated deception tactics
Implement strict email authentication and anomaly detection

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data to corrupt machine learning models, causing misclassification or enabling evasion.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust ML algorithms resistant to poisoning
Monitor model performance for anomalies

problems.description: Attackers not only encrypt victim data but also exfiltrate it, threatening to release sensitive information publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Maintain offline backups and test recovery procedures
Implement network segmentation and least privilege
Monitor for data exfiltration indicators and insider threats
